description: The Mainline record editor failed to open on the web: a bare USEREMAIL() call threw
financial_impact: None: no records could be saved, none were mis-valued
operational_impact: Record entry blocked on the web until fixed
root_cause: USEREMAIL() is not reliably available in the Data Events runtime
correction: v7.1.0 removed the call (bba3f30); creator identity comes from _created_by_id (22b3148)
preventive_action: tests/runtime-globals.test.js fails any script that calls an unguarded runtime global

description: Unit was erased on every save of a Mainline record; the same defect was then found in Scope Line and Change Order
records: PRD-2026-143C1840 (still has a null unit, OI-19)
financial_impact: Records with no unit drop out of footage totals; 1 test record, $6,000 SUBMITTED, never approved
operational_impact: Footage and remaining-work reports undercount any affected record
root_cause: The script parsed unit from the labor code choice LABEL; the runtime exposes no labels, so the parse missed and cleared the field
correction: Fill-only, never-clear unit logic (a2f729b, b086d3a); unit now copied from the rate (m024 <- r010); deployed 2026-11-09 after the OI-02 outage
preventive_action: Never clear a field a person or copy-down filled; audit-daily D-3 (failed calculation) lists any production with a blank unit

description: Every work date derived one day early (week, month, period) in Mainline, Material Transaction and Structure
records: Every record saved before 2026-11-09 (2 production records, both re-derived on later saves)
financial_impact: A record dated the 1st was reported in the previous month: wrong period for billing
operational_impact: Monthly and weekly reports shifted at period boundaries
root_cause: Date-only fields arrive as UTC midnight and were read with local getters

description: forms_update refused every write for about seven weeks, including a call with no changes (OI-02)
financial_impact: Indirect: the unit and date fixes (INC-0002, INC-0003) could not be deployed for 48 days
operational_impact: No script or schema could be changed
root_cause: The claude.ai connector write path; auth, role and payload were ruled out
correction: Writes moved to the direct fulcrum-app MCP server (.mcp.json, 558e4d6); all held-back fixes deployed and read back 2026-11-09
preventive_action: Every deployment is read back and diffed; known-good registry preflight (scripts/known_good.py)

description: MC Contractor Rate v1.0.0, live since 2026-09-16 but never committed, cleared unit and description on every save
records: 146 rate records (not affected: they were imported by API, which runs no Data Events)
financial_impact: None realised. Any rate edited in the app would have lost its unit, and production copies its unit from the rate
operational_impact: Latent: the first edit of a rate would have broken the unit copy-down
root_cause: Same label-parse defect as INC-0002, missed because the script was not in the repository
correction: v1.1.0 deployed 2026-11-09 (6b2a9a3); v1.0.0 committed unchanged first (2c363e4)
preventive_action: Every live script is in the repo and in fulcrum/known-good/registry.json; v1.0.0 is marked never-redeploy

detected_by: Report review against live status lists
description: Three report filter defects: a CANCELLED change order counted as unresolved; REJECTED/SUPERSEDED mappings counted as coverage; DRAFT scope lines counted as authorized scope
financial_impact: Authorized scope and closeout readiness would have been overstated once scope lines exist
operational_impact: Wrong closeout blockers and material coverage
root_cause: Status filters written without reading each app's live status list

description: A user who entered or submitted production could approve it: segregation of duties on the money path was not enforced (OI-22)
financial_impact: Unbounded: one person could create and approve their own pay quantity
root_cause: The approval gate checked the data, not the people; the Contractor role holds can_change_status
correction: v7.7.0 blocks approval by the inspector or submitter (97b67c8); weekly audit W-8 and the approval_independence column report any self-approval
preventive_action: Role change still needed: remove can_change_status from Contractor (docs/uat/role-model.md)

detected_by: Sprint 0 read of the production app
description: Two live API credentials (Fulcrum and Smartsheet) are string literals in the production app's Data Event, which syncs to every device (OI-01)
operational_impact: Anyone who can sync the app can read full-account credentials
root_cause: Credentials embedded in a client-side script
correction: None yet: needs the account owner. Nothing was changed in the production app (read-only constraint)
preventive_action: Rule: credentials server-side only (Sprint 30 section 7, rule 1); never revive the Smartsheet code as written

description: A SUBMITTED production record has a null unit, so it drops out of footage totals: PRD-2026-143C1840, $6,000
root_cause: Created before the unit copy-down existed (INC-0002)
correction: Re-select its rate in the app (OI-19). Records cannot be edited from this toolchain
preventive_action: The daily audit reports it every day until it is fixed
